skills.description: Use this skill when someone hands you a new parcel/地块 layer (often "甲方给的底图") and asks "能不能换成这套地块做" / "能不能做成 XX地块 的" / "我们的成果能不能落到这套地块上". Decides whether a candidate parcel layer can replace the base layer of an existing delivery, via six hard checks — area coverage vs administrative boundary, spatial coverage grid, overlap with the current result, overlap with the insurance/承保 layer (identity test), unit sanity (dkmj vs mj ratio), and the union test for "can we just add another layer (e.g. 大户层) to make it enough" proposals. Covers the trap of confusing "multi-town layer" with "incomplete per town", the subset-vs-complement confusion (when adds have zero gain), the 0-overlap tell, and the polygon-per-parcel count-vs-area split.
